classic_pour_over_0.phrase: Bloom Phase, 45 seconds. Saturate grounds evenly with 3x coffee weight in circular motion. Let coffee bloom and de-gas.
classic_pour_over_0.name: Bloom Phase
classic_pour_over_0.instruction: Saturate grounds evenly with 3x coffee weight in circular motion. Let coffee bloom and de-gas.

classic_pour_over_1.phrase: First Pulse Pour, 45 seconds. Pour in gentle spirals from center outward to raise the slurry level evenly.
classic_pour_over_1.name: First Pulse Pour
classic_pour_over_1.instruction: Pour in gentle spirals from center outward to raise the slurry level evenly.

classic_pour_over_2.phrase: Second Pulse Pour, 45 seconds. Pour second pulse in steady circles, maintaining consistent slurry temperature.
classic_pour_over_2.name: Second Pulse Pour
classic_pour_over_2.instruction: Pour second pulse in steady circles, maintaining consistent slurry temperature.

classic_pour_over_3.phrase: Final Drawdown, 1 minute. Top up final water in center. Allow even flat-bed drawdown.
classic_pour_over_3.name: Final Drawdown
classic_pour_over_3.instruction: Top up final water in center. Allow even flat-bed drawdown.

pour_over_0.phrase: Bloom Phase, 45 seconds. Pour 3x coffee weight in circular motion. Let coffee expand and off-gas CO2.
pour_over_0.name: Bloom Phase
pour_over_0.instruction: Pour 3x coffee weight in circular motion. Let coffee expand and off-gas CO2.

pour_over_1.phrase: Main Concentric Pour, 1 minute. Slow concentric pour from center outward. Keep water level steady.
pour_over_1.name: Main Concentric Pour
pour_over_1.instruction: Slow concentric pour from center outward. Keep water level steady.

pour_over_2.phrase: Final Center Pour & Drawdown, 75 seconds. Gently top up remaining water in center. Allow full bed drawdown.
pour_over_2.name: Final Center Pour & Drawdown
pour_over_2.instruction: Gently top up remaining water in center. Allow full bed drawdown.

chemex_0.phrase: Bloom Phase, 45 seconds. Saturate grounds with 3x coffee weight. Allow heavy bloom for 45 seconds.
chemex_0.name: Bloom Phase
chemex_0.instruction: Saturate grounds with 3x coffee weight. Allow heavy bloom for 45 seconds.

chemex_1.phrase: Slow Spiral Pulse Pour, 90 seconds. Pour in slow steady spirals avoiding the outer glass filter rim.
chemex_1.name: Slow Spiral Pulse Pour
chemex_1.instruction: Pour in slow steady spirals avoiding the outer glass filter rim.

chemex_2.phrase: Final Drawdown & Filter Lift, 105 seconds. Allow complete drawdown through thick paper filter. Lift filter and discard.
chemex_2.name: Final Drawdown & Filter Lift
chemex_2.instruction: Allow complete drawdown through thick paper filter. Lift filter and discard.

french_press_0.phrase: Full Immersion Steep, 4 minutes. Pour all water aggressively over grounds. Place lid on top to retain heat.
french_press_0.name: Full Immersion Steep
french_press_0.instruction: Pour all water aggressively over grounds. Place lid on top to retain heat.

french_press_1.phrase: Stir & Crust Skim, 30 seconds. Gently stir crust. Skim top foam and floating bits with two spoons.
french_press_1.name: Stir & Crust Skim
french_press_1.instruction: Gently stir crust. Skim top foam and floating bits with two spoons.

french_press_2.phrase: Sediment Settle Rest, 5 minutes. Insert plunger without pressing down. Rest 5 mins to let fine silt settle.
french_press_2.name: Sediment Settle Rest
french_press_2.instruction: Insert plunger without pressing down. Rest 5 mins to let fine silt settle.

drip_brewer_0.phrase: Filter Rinse & Reservoir Fill, 30 seconds. Pre-rinse paper filter with hot water. Fill reservoir with cold filtered water.
drip_brewer_0.name: Filter Rinse & Reservoir Fill
drip_brewer_0.instruction: Pre-rinse paper filter with hot water. Fill reservoir with cold filtered water.

drip_brewer_1.phrase: Showerhead Brew Cycle, 3 minutes. Start brew cycle. Ensure grounds bed is evenly saturated by showerhead.
drip_brewer_1.name: Showerhead Brew Cycle
drip_brewer_1.instruction: Start brew cycle. Ensure grounds bed is evenly saturated by showerhead.

drip_brewer_2.phrase: Thermal Carafe Hold, 1 minute. Brew complete. Remove carafe immediately to prevent hotplate scorching.
drip_brewer_2.name: Thermal Carafe Hold
drip_brewer_2.instruction: Brew complete. Remove carafe immediately to prevent hotplate scorching.

moka_pot_0.phrase: Water Reservoir Fill & Basket Prep, 30 seconds. Fill lower chamber with boiling water to safety valve. Level grounds in funnel without packing tightly.
moka_pot_0.name: Water Reservoir Fill & Basket Prep
moka_pot_0.instruction: Fill lower chamber with boiling water to safety valve. Level grounds in funnel without packing tightly.

moka_pot_1.phrase: Stovetop Low Heat Heating, 3 minutes. Place on medium-low heat with lid open. Steam pressure forces water upward through basket.
moka_pot_1.name: Stovetop Low Heat Heating
moka_pot_1.instruction: Place on medium-low heat with lid open. Steam pressure forces water upward through basket.

moka_pot_2.phrase: Crema Sputter & Cold Towel Stop, 45 seconds. When honey-gold stream turns pale and begins sputtering, remove from burner immediately and wrap base in cold wet towel.
moka_pot_2.name: Crema Sputter & Cold Towel Stop
moka_pot_2.instruction: When honey-gold stream turns pale and begins sputtering, remove from burner immediately and wrap base in cold wet towel.

espresso_0.phrase: Pre-Infusion, 8 seconds. Gentle low pressure saturation to prevent puck channeling.
espresso_0.name: Pre-Infusion
espresso_0.instruction: Gentle low pressure saturation to prevent puck channeling.

espresso_1.phrase: Main Pressure Extraction, 25 seconds. Full 9-bar pressure extraction aiming for 1:2 yield ratio.
espresso_1.name: Main Pressure Extraction
espresso_1.instruction: Full 9-bar pressure extraction aiming for 1:2 yield ratio.

aeropress_0.phrase: Steep & Agitate, 1 minute. Pour hot water, stir vigorously 10 times, let steep inverted.
aeropress_0.name: Steep & Agitate
aeropress_0.instruction: Pour hot water, stir vigorously 10 times, let steep inverted.

aeropress_1.phrase: Cap & Flip Rest, 30 seconds. Attach filter cap, carefully flip onto sturdy mug.
aeropress_1.name: Cap & Flip Rest
aeropress_1.instruction: Attach filter cap, carefully flip onto sturdy mug.

aeropress_2.phrase: Gentle Plunge, 30 seconds. Apply steady downward pressure until subtle hiss sound.
aeropress_2.name: Gentle Plunge
aeropress_2.instruction: Apply steady downward pressure until subtle hiss sound.

darjeeling_tea_0.phrase: Vessel Preheat, 15 seconds. Rinse porcelain or glass teapot with warm water to maintain steep temperature.
darjeeling_tea_0.name: Vessel Preheat
darjeeling_tea_0.instruction: Rinse porcelain or glass teapot with warm water to maintain steep temperature.

darjeeling_tea_1.phrase: Aromatic Himalayan Steep, 3 minutes. Pour 88°C water over leaves. Steep 3 minutes for peak muscatel grape bouquet.
darjeeling_tea_1.name: Aromatic Himalayan Steep
darjeeling_tea_1.instruction: Pour 88°C water over leaves. Steep 3 minutes for peak muscatel grape bouquet.

darjeeling_tea_2.phrase: Decant & Serve, 30 seconds. Strain completely into teacup to stop extraction.
darjeeling_tea_2.name: Decant & Serve
darjeeling_tea_2.instruction: Strain completely into teacup to stop extraction.

chai_masala_0.phrase: Spice & Leaf Decoction Simmer, 4 minutes. Boil crushed spices and tea leaves in water for 4 minutes to extract essential oils.
chai_masala_0.name: Spice & Leaf Decoction Simmer
chai_masala_0.instruction: Boil crushed spices and tea leaves in water for 4 minutes to extract essential oils.

chai_masala_1.phrase: Milk & Sweetener Rest, 2 minutes. Add milk and unrefined cane sugar (Panela/Jaggery); bring to gentle froth.
chai_masala_1.name: Milk & Sweetener Rest
chai_masala_1.instruction: Add milk and unrefined cane sugar (Panela/Jaggery); bring to gentle froth.

chai_masala_2.phrase: Fine Mesh Strain, 30 seconds. Pour through fine sieve into mug.
chai_masala_2.name: Fine Mesh Strain
chai_masala_2.instruction: Pour through fine sieve into mug.

english_breakfast_0.phrase: Teapot Warm, 15 seconds. Rinse teapot with near-boiling water.
english_breakfast_0.name: Teapot Warm

english_breakfast_1.phrase: Full Extraction Steep, 4 minutes. Steep at 96°C for 4 minutes for robust body without harshness.
english_breakfast_1.name: Full Extraction Steep
english_breakfast_1.instruction: Steep at 96°C for 4 minutes for robust body without harshness.

english_breakfast_2.phrase: Serve & Rest, 30 seconds. Remove infuser basket completely.
english_breakfast_2.name: Serve & Rest

earl_grey_0.phrase: Vessel Warm, 15 seconds. Rinse ceramic teapot with hot water.
earl_grey_0.name: Vessel Warm
earl_grey_0.instruction: Rinse ceramic teapot with hot water.

earl_grey_1.phrase: Aromatic Citrus Steep, 210 seconds. Steep untouched at 95°C for 3.5 minutes to release citrus aromatics.
earl_grey_1.name: Aromatic Citrus Steep
earl_grey_1.instruction: Steep untouched at 95°C for 3.5 minutes to release citrus aromatics.

earl_grey_2.phrase: Decant, 30 seconds. Separate tea leaves from liqueur.
earl_grey_2.name: Decant

green_tea_0.phrase: Vessel Preheat, 15 seconds. Warm teapot or glass with warm water, then discard water.
green_tea_0.name: Vessel Preheat
green_tea_0.instruction: Warm teapot or glass with warm water, then discard water.

green_tea_1.phrase: 1st Steeping Infusion, 2 minutes. Pour 78°C water gently over leaves. Do not agitate.
green_tea_1.name: 1st Steeping Infusion
green_tea_1.instruction: Pour 78°C water gently over leaves. Do not agitate.

green_tea_2.phrase: Decant & 2nd Infusion Prep, 90 seconds. Pour completely into server. Leaves ready for 2nd steep.
green_tea_2.name: Decant & 2nd Infusion Prep
green_tea_2.instruction: Pour completely into server. Leaves ready for 2nd steep.

matcha_tea_0.phrase: Sift & Warm Bowl, 20 seconds. Sift 2g matcha powder through fine mesh into warm Chawan bowl.
matcha_tea_0.name: Sift & Warm Bowl
matcha_tea_0.instruction: Sift 2g matcha powder through fine mesh into warm Chawan bowl.

matcha_tea_1.phrase: Water Add & Bloom, 15 seconds. Pour 70mL of 80°C water gently down side of bowl.
matcha_tea_1.name: Water Add & Bloom
matcha_tea_1.instruction: Pour 70mL of 80°C water gently down side of bowl.

matcha_tea_2.phrase: Chasen Bamboo Whisk, 45 seconds. Whisk rapidly in a zig-zag "W" motion using bamboo Chasen until rich froth forms.
matcha_tea_2.name: Chasen Bamboo Whisk
matcha_tea_2.instruction: Whisk rapidly in a zig-zag "W" motion using bamboo Chasen until rich froth forms.

oolong_tea_0.phrase: Leaf Wash Rinse, 10 seconds. Quick 10-second flash pour to wake rolled leaves; discard liquid.
oolong_tea_0.name: Leaf Wash Rinse
oolong_tea_0.instruction: Quick 10-second flash pour to wake rolled leaves; discard liquid.

oolong_tea_1.phrase: 1st Infusion, 45 seconds. Steep 45 seconds at 88°C for rich aroma peak.
oolong_tea_1.name: 1st Infusion
oolong_tea_1.instruction: Steep 45 seconds at 88°C for rich aroma peak.

oolong_tea_2.phrase: 2nd Infusion, 1 minute. Add 15s to steep time. Full floral body unfolding.
oolong_tea_2.name: 2nd Infusion
oolong_tea_2.instruction: Add 15s to steep time. Full floral body unfolding.

ceylon_tea_0.phrase: Vessel Warm, 15 seconds. Rinse teapot with hot water.
ceylon_tea_0.name: Vessel Warm

ceylon_tea_1.phrase: Brisk Mountain Steep, 210 seconds. Steep at 95°C for 3.5 minutes for bright citrus acidity.
ceylon_tea_1.name: Brisk Mountain Steep
ceylon_tea_1.instruction: Steep at 95°C for 3.5 minutes for bright citrus acidity.

ceylon_tea_2.phrase: Decant & Serve, 30 seconds. Strain completely into cup.
ceylon_tea_2.name: Decant & Serve

white_tea_0.phrase: Vessel Preheat, 15 seconds. Warm ceramic teapot with warm water.
white_tea_0.name: Vessel Preheat
white_tea_0.instruction: Warm ceramic teapot with warm water.

white_tea_1.phrase: Long Floral Infusion, 3 minutes. Steep untouched at 83°C to unlock delicate essential oils.
white_tea_1.name: Long Floral Infusion
white_tea_1.instruction: Steep untouched at 83°C to unlock delicate essential oils.

white_tea_2.phrase: Decant, 30 seconds. Strain fully to prevent over-steeping the leaves.
white_tea_2.name: Decant
white_tea_2.instruction: Strain fully to prevent over-steeping the leaves.

turmeric_tea_0.phrase: Botanical Hydration, 15 seconds. Place crushed turmeric and botanicals into infuser.
turmeric_tea_0.name: Botanical Hydration
turmeric_tea_0.instruction: Place crushed turmeric and botanicals into infuser.

turmeric_tea_1.phrase: Deep Botanical Steep, 5 minutes. Steep 5 minutes with boiling 98°C water for rich golden extraction.
turmeric_tea_1.name: Deep Botanical Steep
turmeric_tea_1.instruction: Steep 5 minutes with boiling 98°C water for rich golden extraction.

turmeric_tea_2.phrase: Honey & Citrus Stir, 30 seconds. Stir in raw honey and squeeze of fresh lemon.
turmeric_tea_2.name: Honey & Citrus Stir
turmeric_tea_2.instruction: Stir in raw honey and squeeze of fresh lemon.
